I added `print(f"refund amount_cents={amount_cents}")` as the first line of `refund()` in `src/billing/refunds.py:5`. It prints only the amount, with no customer data, so it doesn't break the project's no-PII-in-logs rule. I haven't run anything to see it print.

One thing I noticed while reading the file: the project memory says refunds over 50,000 cents ($500) should be created as `pending_approval` for a second person to approve. `refund()` doesn't do that. It issues any amount up to the invoice total directly. That's outside what you asked, so I didn't touch it, but it might matter for what you're debugging.
